name: FluoTest API
description:
FluoTest's MCP server and supporting API surface. /api/mcp uses the Model Context Protocol's JSON-RPC 2.0 Streamable HTTP transport (https://modelcontextprotocol.io). Tools: create_quiz, list_quizzes, get_quiz_questions, get_quiz_settings, update_quiz, publish_quiz, get_results, delete_quiz; call tools/list for their input and output JSON schemas. Connection guide: https://fluotest.com/en/docs/mcp-server. API reference: https://fluotest.com/en/docs/api-reference.

Errors: HTTP-level failures return a typed error body, RFC 9457 application/problem+json with a stable `code` and a `hint`, except 401/403 from the OAuth layer, which use the RFC 6750 error body plus a WWW-Authenticate header. Tool-level failures come back as a JSON-RPC result with isError: true.

Rate limits: every response carries RateLimit-Policy/RateLimit (IETF draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers) and RateLimit-Limit/-Remaining/-Reset; a 429 adds Retry-After.

Versioning: the transport is versioned by the MCP-Protocol-Version request header (MCP's date-based protocol versions; supported: 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05, 2024-10-07). The tool surface follows semantic versioning in info.version: new tools and new optional arguments are additive and never break existing calls. A breaking change ships as a new tool name; the old tool keeps working for at least 90 days, responses that use it carry a Deprecation header (RFC 9745) and a Sunset header (RFC 8594) with the removal date, and the change is announced on the changelog (/en/changelog).
